name: Abridge
product: Enterprise clinical AI platform that converts patient-clinician conversations into structured documentation and supports coding, evidence and follow-on workflows.
targetCustomer: Health systems, hospitals and ambulatory provider organizations
buyer: Chief Medical Information Officer, Chief Digital Officer or clinical operations leader
latestRound: Series E extension, Apr 2026 ($316M); strategic investments announced Jun 2026 with terms undisclosed
traction: Abridge reported deployments at more than 150 enterprise health systems in Jun 2025 and expanded from documentation into clinical, financial and evidence workflows in Jun 2026.
notes: The approximately $830M aggregate is from a credible secondary source and includes a reported 2026 Series E extension; Abridge did not disclose the later strategic-investment amount. Adoption and workflow metrics are company-reported.

name: Ambience Healthcare
subsector: Ambient documentation, coding and clinical documentation integrity

name: Tennr
product: AI referral-orchestration platform that reads inbound clinical documents, checks eligibility and routes patients through provider intake workflows.
targetCustomer: Specialty provider groups, durable medical equipment suppliers and post-acute providers
buyer: Chief Operating Officer, patient-access leader or revenue-cycle executive
traction: At the Series C, Tennr reported hundreds of provider organizations, millions of patients processed and revenue growth of more than 3x since its Series B.
notes: Traction is company-reported. The total-funding figure comes from a financing database; the $101M latest round is directly announced. Referral-network effects are plausible but not yet independently quantified.

name: AKASA
product: Generative AI platform for medical coding, clinical documentation integrity, prior authorization and other health-system revenue-cycle workflows.
targetCustomer: Health systems, hospitals and academic medical centers
buyer: Chief Financial Officer, revenue-cycle executive or health-information-management leader
traction: Cleveland Clinic completed an AKASA coding rollout across all U.S. locations and had processed tens of thousands of encounters before expanding into clinical documentation integrity in Oct 2025.
notes: The last disclosed financing is stale, but a 2025 enterprise-wide Cleveland Clinic deployment is a current execution signal. The 250M-claim training corpus often cited by AKASA dates to 2021 and should not be treated as a current independent benchmark.

name: Aidoc
subsector: Radiology AI and clinical care coordination
product: Clinical AI platform for imaging-based case prioritization, diagnostic support and cross-specialty care coordination through an enterprise AI operating layer.
targetCustomer: Hospitals, radiology groups and integrated health systems
buyer: Chief Medical Officer, radiology chair, Chief Information Officer or clinical AI leader
traction: Aidoc reported deployment in nearly 2,000 hospitals and analysis of more than 120M cases when announcing a Jun 2026 FDA Breakthrough Device designation for investigational report drafting.
notes: The Series E announcement says total funding exceeded $500M but does not provide an exact aggregate. FDA Breakthrough Device designation expedites interaction with FDA; it is not marketing clearance for the investigational First Read product.

name: Ibex Medical Analytics
product: Computational pathology platform that helps pathologists detect, grade and quantify cancer on digitized tissue slides.
targetCustomer: Pathology laboratories, hospitals and health systems

traction: Ibex reports a training and validation corpus exceeding 10M slide images; FDA records show 510(k) clearance for Galen Second Read for prostate biopsies in Jan 2025.
notes: The company discloses only that total funding exceeds $100M. The cited FDA clearance is scoped to a prostate second-read product and should not be generalized to every Galen module or cancer type.

name: Rad AI
product: Generative AI radiology platform that drafts report impressions, supports full report generation and manages follow-up recommendations.
targetCustomer: Radiology practices, hospitals and health systems
buyer: Radiology chair, practice executive or Chief Medical Information Officer
traction: Rad AI states that its products are used by radiologists serving roughly 40% of U.S. health systems; this market-share claim is company-reported.
notes: The proprietary-report corpus and deep PACS/RIS workflow integration support defensibility, but reported market reach is not an independently audited revenue metric. Reporting assistance should not be conflated with autonomous diagnosis.

buyer: Biopharma research executive or business-development leader

name: Isomorphic Labs

traction: The company announced its IsoDDE drug-design engine in Feb 2026 and raised $2.1B in May 2026 to scale its internal pipeline and external collaborations.
notes: Capital and technical lineage are exceptional, but disclosed benchmark and pipeline claims are company-reported and human clinical efficacy remains unproven. The business is an integrated drug developer and partner, not a conventional SaaS platform.

name: Unlearn

product: Clinical-trial design platform that builds disease-specific AI digital twins to support synthetic-control methods, prognostic modeling and trial planning.

product: Multimodal precision-medicine platform combining clinical and molecular diagnostics, licensed healthcare data, clinical decision tools and trial matching.
